_why: High or critical advisories accepted until review_by, pinned to the install paths npm flagged; anything else, or an expired date, fails the scan.

decode-uri-component.why: Dev tooling only: Expo SDK 58's @expo/cli pulls expo-router@57 (for @expo/router-server) and through it query-string@7 / decode-uri-component; the app bundle uses expo-router 58. Fix lands when @expo/cli moves off expo-router 57 — recheck at each Expo patch (docs/SECURITY.md)
